fomod.Name: Lyza's SkyrimNet_DDUDNG fixes
fomod.Author: Lyza / Grok
fomod.Description:
SkyrimNet + Devious Devices prompt overlay. No ESP of its own.
Feedback / support thread: https://discord.com/channels/1287232260617015336/1544716621610877018
Installer picks the world tone: - Medium — RP-focused. Shops and quests stay shops and quests unless she asked, or they are predators / shady / arresting. - Hard — being made a pet. Locking an adult woman is ordinary manners.
Occupancy, combat omit, women-only, gagged speech, and the remote are the same either way.
Optional second page: Experimental — SLO arousal bands and follower remote play. Needs SLO Aroused / SkyrimNet_Arousal to mean anything; without them the extra page is inert.
Hard requirements, credited: SkyrimNet_UDNG by naitro2010 (https://github.com/naitro2010/SkyrimNet_UDNG) and DD SkyrimNet AddOn V1.1-beta by telord (Discord link above). Neither is bundled here.
